freezeNote: v1.1 was frozen before any pilot model run; it adds matched batching/context and explicit absent-target scoring discovered during pre-run PR review.
researchQuestion: Does generative overlay grounding improve spatial localization accuracy over direct coordinate prediction?

sample.targetPolicy: Evaluate every planned region and interactive element. Do not remove targets that are absent in the rendered map.

fairnessControls.note: DirectCoord and GridCoord match GOG's region/element separation and maximum batch size to reduce batching confounds.

goNoGo.go: GOG improves at least two primary metrics over DirectCoord with the same direction on a majority of maps, without a materially worse absentFalsePositiveRate.
goNoGo.partialGo: GOG does not improve mean IoU but materially lowers missing rate or NCE; reframe the claim around robustness rather than precision, subject to absent-target false-positive analysis.
goNoGo.noGo: DirectCoord dominates GOG on meanIoUAll, meanNCEAll, recallAt03, and missingRate; do not retain GOG as the main contribution without a new mechanism.

auditRules: Do not edit pilot prompts after the first generation run.
Do not tune extraction thresholds on the ten pilot maps after viewing aggregate test metrics.
Record model identifiers, timestamps, raw responses, call counts, and source artifacts.
A verifier API failure is verifier_unavailable, never verified_pass.
Any protocol change after the first pilot model run requires a new versioned config.
